description:
**Business value:** Enables compliant access to regulated products in supported international markets.

**Technical requirements:** Use an adapter-based KYC integration, encrypted/minimized PII, versioned eligibility rules, fail-closed decisions, and immutable auditing.

**Acceptance criteria:** A verified user receives deterministic provider/product eligibility; an ineligible user cannot receive or execute a trade; every decision is reconstructable.

**Dependencies:** `FND-006`, `SEC-002`, `SEC-003`

**Owner:** Compliance Product; Compliance Backend; Security; Web/Mobile

**Business value:** Keeps the launch within approved international markets and excludes the United States.

**Technical requirements:** Use versioned jurisdiction policy, trusted residency evidence, server-side product gates, approved disclosures, and monitoring.

**Acceptance criteria:** U.S., unsupported, unknown, and conflicted users cannot access executable products; supported users can; the applied policy version and reason are logged.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-EPIC`, `SEC-003`

**Owner:** Legal/Compliance; Compliance Backend; Security; Web/Mobile

**Business value:** Enables company-level search and comparison without treating distinct tokenized securities as fungible.

**Technical requirements:** Model canonical underlyings, provider-specific securities, full issuer/chain/contract/custody/redemption metadata, fungibility identity, and catalog provenance.

**Acceptance criteria:** Multiple AAPL products group under Apple while retaining separate legal, token, venue, and settlement identities.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-EPIC`

**Owner:** Securities Backend; Data; Compliance

**Business value:** Adds the first regulated production execution venue.

**Technical requirements:** Select a provider, then implement secure catalog, quote/order, lifecycle, reconciliation, and operational adapters.

**Acceptance criteria:** An eligible user can buy and sell through Provider 1; all fees, identifiers, states, and discrepancies are recorded.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-EPIC`, `P4-KYC-EPIC`, `P4-JUR-EPIC`, `EP-LED`

**Owner:** Partner Integrations; Securities Backend; Security; SRE

**Business value:** Meets the MVP requirement for two distinct production providers.

**Technical requirements:** Integrate a second regulated provider through the same normalized contracts and transaction controls.

**Acceptance criteria:** A second distinct provider passes production buy/sell, ledger, security, and reconciliation tests.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-EPIC`, `P4-KYC-EPIC`, `P4-JUR-EPIC`, `EP-LED`

**Owner:** Partner Integrations; Securities Backend; Security; SRE

**Business value:** Expands provider coverage and is targeted before full public launch.

**Technical requirements:** Integrate a third regulated provider without provider-specific changes in downstream consumers.

**Acceptance criteria:** Provider 3 passes the shared production contract and control suite; Provider 1 and 2 remain the MVP minimum.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PRV1-EPIC`, `P5-PRV2-EPIC`, `P5-INS-EPIC`

**Owner:** Partner Integrations; Securities Backend; Security; SRE

**Business value:** Finds the best eligible all-in executable route while hiding provider and settlement complexity.

**Technical requirements:** Filter by eligibility, fan out executable quotes, calculate total cost, rank deterministically, bind confirmations, and correlate execution to the ledger.

**Acceptance criteria:** With two production providers, stale and ineligible routes never execute and the lowest valid all-in route is selected reproducibly.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PRV1-EPIC`, `P5-PRV2-EPIC`, `ROU-006`, `FEE-002`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Quant; Partner Integrations; SRE

**Business value:** Provides accurate tokenized-market data as primary and underlying-equity data only as reference.

**Technical requirements:** Use licensed sources, normalized live/history schemas, explicit source typing, freshness controls, and data-quality monitoring.

**Acceptance criteria:** Bid, ask, price, volume, candles, and market status are available; reference prices and premium/discount are distinctly labeled and never substituted for executable quotes.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-EPIC`, `P5-PRV1-EPIC`, `P5-PRV2-EPIC`

**Owner:** Market Data Backend; Data Engineering; Quant; SRE

**Business value:** Delivers the defined Free, Individual, and Pro analysis experiences.

**Technical requirements:** Render tokenized candles and quotes, reference comparison, defined indicators, advanced interactions, and entitlement hooks.

**Acceptance criteria:** Each tier receives only its defined capabilities and every chart identifies the correct source and freshness.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-EPIC`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; Market Data Backend; Quant

**Business value:** Provides transparent provider comparison without presenting different securities as one book.

**Technical requirements:** Build distinct-instrument comparison, fungibility guards, optional Level II/time-and-sales, and controlled limit orders.

**Acceptance criteria:** Different issuer or token contracts remain separate; aggregation occurs only for the same verified fungible security.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-EPIC`, `P5-ROUTER-EPIC`, `P5-MDATA-EPIC`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Market Data; Web/Mobile; Compliance

**Business value:** Shows both displayed value and realistically realizable sell value.

**Technical requirements:** Maintain reconciled positions, value them with tokenized data, request size-aware executable sell quotes, and itemize slippage and costs.

**Acceptance criteria:** Settled positions appear accurately and estimated sell value uses executable liquidity rather than last-trade price alone.

**Dependencies:** `EP-LED`, `EP-REC`, `P5-ROUTER-EPIC`, `P5-MDATA-EPIC`

**Owner:** Portfolio Backend; Quant; Web/Mobile; Data/SRE

summary: Select KYC provider and integration approach
description:
**Business value:** Resolves regulatory, provider, and data-handling uncertainty before implementation.

**Technical requirements:** Compare international coverage, residency/investor checks, SDK/API/webhooks, security, retention, manual review, SLA, and production access; produce a decision record and requirements map.

**Acceptance criteria:** Compliance, Security, and Engineering approve one provider or document a no-go; sandbox and production prerequisites are explicit.

**Dependencies:** `FND-006`

**Owner:** Compliance Product; Legal; Security; Partner Backend

summary: Implement secure KYC subject and status model
description:
**Business value:** Creates a reliable eligibility input while minimizing sensitive data.

**Technical requirements:** Persist encrypted provider references and normalized pending/review/verified/rejected/expired states; do not retain raw identity documents unless explicitly approved.

**Acceptance criteria:** Unauthorized reads are denied; every state change records actor, source, time, and audit correlation; migration and state tests pass.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-01`, `SEC-002`, `SEC-003`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Data; Security

**Business value:** Lets users start and resume identity verification.

**Technical requirements:** Implement the selected provider adapter plus idempotent create/resume APIs with server-held credentials, correlation IDs, bounded retries, and normalized errors.

**Acceptance criteria:** Repeated identical requests return the same active session; sandbox success, timeout, and provider-rejection tests pass.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-01`, `P4-KYC-02`, `FND-006`

**Owner:** Partner Backend; Compliance Backend; Security

**Business value:** Keeps verification state current without trusting client assertions.

**Technical requirements:** Verify webhook signatures, prevent replay, process idempotently, protect against out-of-order events, and dead-letter unrecoverable payloads.

**Acceptance criteria:** Invalid signatures are rejected; duplicate callbacks make one mutation; late events cannot regress terminal state.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-02`, `P4-KYC-03`, `SEC-005`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Platform; Security/SRE

summary: Build KYC onboarding and status UI
description:
**Business value:** Reduces onboarding abandonment and gives users safe status guidance.

**Technical requirements:** Provide start/resume flows and accessible normalized status/reason states on web/mobile; exclude sensitive provider payloads from client logs.

**Acceptance criteria:** Users can start and resume verification; every normalized state renders correctly; the client cannot mark itself verified.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-03`, `P4-KYC-04`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; UX; Compliance Backend

**Business value:** Allows access rules to evolve without code changes.

**Technical requirements:** Represent country, KYC status, investor class, provider, product, effective dates, policy version, and stable reason codes; require maker/checker publication.

**Acceptance criteria:** Automated cases cover provider-, product-, country-, and classification-specific rules; missing or unknown inputs fail closed.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-01`, `P4-JUR-01`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Legal/Compliance; Data

**Business value:** Gives search and routing one authoritative eligibility decision.

**Technical requirements:** Return deterministic decisions with policy version and reason codes; invalidate bounded caches when KYC, residency, classification, or policy changes.

**Acceptance criteria:** Identical inputs/version return identical decisions; changed inputs invalidate prior results; missing data never returns eligible.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-06`, `P4-JUR-03`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Platform

summary: Enforce eligibility before quote and execution
description:
**Business value:** Prevents prohibited trading and client-side bypasses.

**Technical requirements:** Apply server-side gates before executable quote presentation and again at confirmation; bind eligibility/policy version to the quote.

**Acceptance criteria:** Ineligible instruments receive no executable quote; direct API bypass is denied; eligibility revoked after quote blocks confirmation.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-07`, `PRE-003`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Execution Backend; Security

summary: Audit eligibility decisions and queue reviews
description:
**Business value:** Supports regulatory evidence and human exception handling.

**Technical requirements:** Write redacted immutable decision inputs/results and emit one operations event for review-required cases.

**Acceptance criteria:** An auditor can reconstruct a decision without raw documents; a review case appears exactly once in the operations queue.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-07`, `SEC-003`, `OPS-004`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Admin Backend; Security

**Business value:** Prevents engineering from inventing legal availability rules.

**Technical requirements:** Produce a signed-off matrix covering U.S. exclusion, residency basis, investor classes, provider/product restrictions, disclosures, and policy ownership.

**Acceptance criteria:** Every launch provider/product/jurisdiction combination has an approved allow, deny, or review outcome and effective date.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-01`

**Owner:** Legal/Compliance; Product

**Business value:** Makes market controls consistent, changeable, and auditable.

**Technical requirements:** Store effective-dated market/provider/product availability with immutable published versions, maker/checker approval, and rollback.

**Acceptance criteria:** Unpublished edits have no production effect; effective-date and rollback tests pass; requests can identify the applied version.

**Dependencies:** `P4-JUR-01`, `SEC-003`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Data; Admin Backend

**Business value:** Avoids treating spoofable client geography as authoritative.

**Technical requirements:** Use verified KYC residency as authority; model unknown/conflict states and optional IP/device risk signals without silently overwriting KYC.

**Acceptance criteria:** Known residency resolves deterministically; unknown/conflicted cases fail closed or enter review; conflicts are audited.

**Dependencies:** `P4-KYC-04`, `P4-JUR-02`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Security/Risk

summary: Enforce U.S. and unsupported-market access gates
description:
**Business value:** Keeps executable products inside the approved launch footprint.

**Technical requirements:** Add central server authorization and pre-trade enforcement with default deny; do not rely on UI controls.

**Acceptance criteria:** U.S., unknown, and blocked test users cannot quote or trade; approved users can; direct API calls cannot bypass the gate.

**Dependencies:** `P4-JUR-02`, `P4-JUR-03`, `P4-KYC-08`

**Owner:** Compliance Backend; Platform; Security

**Business value:** Gives users clear, non-misleading access guidance.

**Technical requirements:** Render localizable supported, unavailable, and review-required states with approved disclosures and no executable CTA for blocked users.

**Acceptance criteria:** Every gate result maps to approved copy; blocked users cannot navigate to confirmation; sensitive rule details are not exposed.

**Dependencies:** `P4-JUR-04`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; UX; Legal/Compliance

**Business value:** Enables rapid response to attempted bypasses and residency conflicts.

**Technical requirements:** Publish redacted metrics by reason/policy version and alert on bypass attempts or signal conflicts with user/request correlation.

**Acceptance criteria:** Synthetic bypass and conflict tests each generate one actionable alert; dashboards expose no raw PII.

**Dependencies:** `P4-JUR-03`, `P4-JUR-04`, `SEC-005`

**Owner:** Security/SRE; Compliance Operations

**Business value:** Creates the company-level entity users search for.

**Technical requirements:** Persist a stable internal ID, ticker, company/security name, reference identifiers, and lifecycle status.

**Acceptance criteria:** AAPL and NVDA resolve by name/ticker to one canonical underlying; identifier collisions are rejected.

**Dependencies:** None

**Owner:** Securities Backend; Data

**Business value:** Preserves each security's legal and settlement identity.

**Technical requirements:** Persist issuer, provider, token, chain, contract, venue, custody/redemption structure, settlement assets, and status.

**Acceptance criteria:** Two AAPL products retain distinct IDs and metadata while referencing one underlying; required identity fields cannot be omitted.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-01`

**Owner:** Securities Backend; Compliance

**Business value:** Prevents false liquidity aggregation across distinct securities.

**Technical requirements:** Build a conservative fungibility key using security/issuer and exact token, chain, and contract identity; default to non-fungible.

**Acceptance criteria:** Different issuer or contract never shares a key; an explicitly verified same token traded at two venues may share one.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-02`

**Owner:** Securities Backend; Compliance; Market Data

**Business value:** Allows provider catalogs to be loaded without corrupting security identity.

**Technical requirements:** Implement idempotent provider-key upserts, schema validation, provenance, deactivate-not-delete, and quarantine for ambiguous mappings.

**Acceptance criteria:** Replay creates no duplicate; invalid metadata is quarantined; updates preserve history and provenance.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-02`, `P5-INS-03`, `SEC-003`

**Owner:** Securities Backend; Data Engineering

**Business value:** Matches how users search for companies rather than token issuers.

**Technical requirements:** Support name/ticker search with pagination and eligibility-filter hooks while returning distinct instrument references.

**Acceptance criteria:** “NVIDIA” and “NVDA” find one underlying; provider instruments remain separate; ineligible instruments can be excluded.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-01`, `P5-INS-04`, `P4-KYC-07`

**Owner:** Securities Backend; Search/Data

**Acceptance criteria:** Product, Legal/Compliance, Security, and Engineering approve a provider distinct from earlier slots and document sandbox/production exit criteria, or record a no-go.

**Acceptance criteria:** Sandbox authentication succeeds; credentials never enter logs; timeout and rate-limit cases return normalized retryable/non-retryable errors.

**Acceptance criteria:** Fixture catalog maps correctly; replay is idempotent; delisted entries deactivate without deleting history.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PRV1-02`, `P5-INS-04`

summary: Define normalized equity quote and order contracts
description:
**Business value:** Keeps provider-specific behavior outside routing logic.

**Technical requirements:** Define provider/instrument IDs, side, quantity/notional, executable price, depth, itemized fees, settlement asset/chain, expiry, and provider order ID.

**Acceptance criteria:** Fixtures for at least two candidate providers validate; missing price, expiry, fee, or settlement data is rejected.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-02`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Partner Integrations

summary: Build eligible candidate and quote fan-out
description:
**Business value:** Compares only executable choices available to the user.

**Technical requirements:** Filter by current eligibility before concurrent quote requests; enforce freshness, timeouts, circuit breakers, and partial-provider failure isolation.

**Acceptance criteria:** Ineligible providers receive no request; one failed provider does not hide another valid quote; stale quotes are excluded.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-01`, `P4-KYC-07`, `P5-PRV1-04`, `P5-PRV2-04`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Compliance Backend; SRE

**Business value:** Enables honest comparison without hidden spreads.

**Technical requirements:** Combine executable price with provider, settlement, funding conversion, network, and platform costs using precise decimal math and itemized output.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden fixtures reproduce expected totals; every cost is exposed; direct settlement receives no material-orchestration fee.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-02`, `ROU-006`, `FEE-002`

**Owner:** Quant; Execution Backend; Finance

summary: Rank equity routes with deterministic risk rules
description:
**Business value:** Selects the best valid route predictably while excluding unsafe routes.

**Technical requirements:** Rank by all-in cost, liquidity/depth, slippage, time, and approved route-risk limits with a deterministic tie-break.

**Acceptance criteria:** Lowest valid all-in route wins in fixtures; hard-limit breaches remove a route; identical inputs produce the same result.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-03`

**Owner:** Quant; Risk; Execution Backend

summary: Bind equity route quotes to confirmation
description:
**Business value:** Prevents stale, altered, or cross-user confirmation.

**Technical requirements:** Persist an opaque quote ID bound to user, request, expiry, eligibility/policy snapshot, and idempotency key; require re-quote after expiry.

**Acceptance criteria:** Another user or altered request cannot confirm; expired quotes fail; repeated confirmation cannot create duplicate execution.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-04`, `PRE-003`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Security

summary: Submit provider order only after funding succeeds
description:
**Business value:** Prevents unfunded or partially funded equity execution.

**Technical requirements:** Wait for every required wallet funding leg, then submit exactly one chosen-provider order and correlate quote, funding, provider, and ledger IDs; never switch venues silently.

**Acceptance criteria:** Any required funding failure prevents submission; success creates one correlated order; retry creates no duplicate.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-05`, `EP-XWT`, `EP-LED`, `P5-PRV1-05`, `P5-PRV2-05`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Ledger Backend; Partner Integrations

summary: Audit and monitor equity routing decisions
description:
**Business value:** Supports best-execution review and rapid operations response.

**Technical requirements:** Record redacted alternatives and rejection reasons with policy/quote correlation; emit latency, failure, expiry, and slippage metrics and alerts.

**Acceptance criteria:** An operator can reconstruct a decision; no-route and expiry cases are distinguishable; synthetic anomalies trigger actionable alerts.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-04`, `P5-ROUTER-06`, `SEC-003`, `SEC-005`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Data; SRE; Compliance Operations

**Business value:** Prevents unsupported data use and identifies coverage gaps before implementation.

**Technical requirements:** Assess tokenized and underlying sources for rights, API/feed access, latency, history, Level II, redistribution, symbol coverage, SLA, and cost; keep tokenized data primary.

**Acceptance criteria:** Legal, Product, and Data approve sources and rights; every planned UI field has a named source or explicit unavailable state.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PRV1-01`, `P5-PRV2-01`

**Owner:** Market Data Product; Legal; Data Engineering

**Business value:** Prevents underlying reference prices from being mistaken for executable token quotes.

**Technical requirements:** Model source/type, instrument, bid/ask/last, volume, market status, timestamp, venue, currency, depth, and quality flags.

**Acceptance criteria:** Tokenized and underlying records cannot be unlabeled or conflated; stale and out-of-order fixtures receive quality flags.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-01`, `P5-INS-02`

**Owner:** Market Data Backend; Data Architecture

summary: Ingest live tokenized data for Providers 1 and 2
description:
**Business value:** Meets the minimum production comparison requirement.

**Technical requirements:** Connect both provider feeds with deduplication, sequence handling, reconnect/backoff, normalized source timestamps, and provider attribution.

**Acceptance criteria:** Both sources populate their available bid/ask/last/volume/status fields; reconnect and replay do not duplicate or reorder publication.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-02`, `P5-PRV1-02`, `P5-PRV2-02`

**Owner:** Data Engineering; Partner Integrations; SRE

summary: Ingest live tokenized data for Provider 3
description:
**Business value:** Adds the public-launch target provider without consumer changes.

**Technical requirements:** Implement Provider 3 through the same normalized feed contract and quality controls.

**Acceptance criteria:** Provider 3 fixtures pass the shared contract suite; downstream consumers contain no Provider 3 special-case branch.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-02`, `P5-PRV3-02`

**Owner:** Data Engineering; Partner Integrations

summary: Store token trades and OHLCV history
description:
**Business value:** Powers historical charts and time-and-sales.

**Technical requirements:** Persist immutable trade provenance and deterministic event-time candles with supported intervals, timezone/session metadata, late events, and corrections.

**Acceptance criteria:** Known trades produce exact OHLCV; late/corrected events recompute affected candles; missing intervals remain explicit gaps.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-03`

**Owner:** Data Engineering; Market Data Backend

summary: Integrate underlying reference data and premium calculation
description:
**Business value:** Lets users assess divergence without altering execution price.

**Technical requirements:** Map licensed underlying symbols, align time/currency, and calculate premium or discount with explicit stale/unavailable behavior.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden cases produce expected percentages; stale reference suppresses comparison; router quotes never substitute the underlying value.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-01`, `P5-MDATA-02`, `P5-INS-01`

**Owner:** Market Data Backend; Quant; Data Engineering

**Business value:** Gives clients a stable, source-aware read boundary.

**Technical requirements:** Expose current quotes, candles, volume, and market status with authentication, range limits, caching, pagination, source, and freshness.

**Acceptance criteria:** Contract tests return all Free fields; invalid ranges are rejected; every response identifies source and freshness.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-03`, `P5-MDATA-05`, `P5-MDATA-06`

**Owner:** Market Data Backend; Platform

**Business value:** Prevents misleading displays and unsafe routing inputs.

**Technical requirements:** Detect stale, crossed, missing, or anomalous feeds; publish quality flags, dashboards, alerts, and a downstream stale-data kill switch.

**Acceptance criteria:** Synthetic stale and crossed quotes are flagged and alerted; stale data is excluded from executable routing.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-03`, `P5-MDATA-07`, `SEC-005`

**Owner:** Data/SRE; Market Data Backend; Risk

**Business value:** Delivers the Free historical chart experience.

**Technical requirements:** Render selectable tokenized-price candles and volume on responsive web/mobile with loading, gap, and error states.

**Acceptance criteria:** Known OHLCV fixtures render exact candles/volume; missing intervals show gaps rather than fabricated values.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-05`, `P5-MDATA-07`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; UX

summary: Display token quote and market status
description:
**Business value:** Gives immediate tradable-market context.

**Technical requirements:** Show token price, bid, ask, volume, market status, source, and freshness with accessible formatting and stale states.

**Acceptance criteria:** UI matches API fixtures; stale/unavailable data cannot appear live; underlying reference is never substituted.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-07`, `P5-MDATA-08`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; Market Data Backend

**Business value:** Provides Individual-level fair-value context.

**Technical requirements:** Display the time-aligned underlying reference and premium/discount with separate legends, sources, and unavailable states.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden fixture shows the correct comparison; stale reference removes only the reference comparison, not the token chart.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-06`, `P5-CHART-01`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; Quant

**Business value:** Supplies defined trend analysis.

**Technical requirements:** Calculate and display configurable SMA and EMA with bounded periods, warm-up behavior, and shared precision fixtures.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden series matches expected SMA and EMA within tolerance; insufficient history is labeled.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-05`, `P5-CHART-01`

**Owner:** Quant; Web/Mobile

**Business value:** Expands the defined analysis set.

**Technical requirements:** Implement session-aware VWAP and a documented RSI convention with period validation and missing-volume handling.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden fixtures match expected values; VWAP is unavailable when required volume is missing; invalid periods fail validation.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-05`, `P5-CHART-01`

**Owner:** Quant; Web/Mobile

**Business value:** Completes the defined Pro indicator list.

**Technical requirements:** Calculate and display MACD, signal, and histogram using documented EMA periods and warm-up rules.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden fixture matches all MACD components within tolerance; invalid configuration is rejected.

**Dependencies:** `P5-CHART-04`

**Owner:** Quant; Web/Mobile

**Business value:** Provides the defined Pro chart experience without adding out-of-scope institutional tooling.

**Technical requirements:** Add range/zoom and indicator-overlay controls with accessible, performant rendering and locally persisted preferences.

**Acceptance criteria:** Users can change range/zoom and toggle supported indicators; the largest supported dataset meets the agreed render budget.

**Dependencies:** `P5-CHART-01`, `P5-CHART-04`, `P5-CHART-05`, `P5-CHART-06`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; UX

**Business value:** Protects subscription value and licensed data.

**Technical requirements:** Apply server-side and UI capability checks for Free, Individual, and Pro; default deny unknown entitlements.

**Acceptance criteria:** Free cannot call paid comparison/indicator APIs; higher tiers receive only defined capabilities; direct API bypass fails.

**Dependencies:** `P7-E22-STR01`, `P5-CHART-03`, `P5-CHART-07`

**Owner:** Platform Backend; Web/Mobile; Billing

**Business value:** Provides transparent comparison across distinct provider securities.

**Technical requirements:** Return separate eligible instruments with buy/sell, spread, liquidity/depth, slippage, premium, provider/settlement/funding costs, redemption, and route total.

**Acceptance criteria:** AAPL fixture returns one row per security; ineligible rows are not executable; route totals match the execution router.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-03`, `P5-INS-05`, `P4-KYC-07`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Quant

**Business value:** Explains provider choices without misleading users about fungibility.

**Technical requirements:** Display issuer/provider/token identity, all-in costs, liquidity, settlement details, route selection, and unavailable reasons in separate rows.

**Acceptance criteria:** Distinct AAPL products never render as one order book; selected route matches API; unavailable rows have no confirm action.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MKT-01`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; UX; Compliance

**Business value:** Prevents false consolidated liquidity.

**Technical requirements:** Require the verified fungibility key before aggregation, retain venue provenance, and default to separate books.

**Acceptance criteria:** Different issuer or contract books remain separate; the same verified token across venues may aggregate with venue attribution.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-03`

**Owner:** Market Data Backend; Securities Backend; Compliance

**Business value:** Enables available Pro depth analysis without inventing liquidity.

**Technical requirements:** Process provider snapshots/deltas with sequence validation, resync, normalized price levels, source, and freshness.

**Acceptance criteria:** Fixtures reconstruct the expected book; a missing sequence triggers resync; unsupported instruments return unavailable.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MDATA-02`, `P5-MKT-03`

**Owner:** Market Data Backend; Data Engineering

summary: Display order book, depth, and time & sales
description:
**Business value:** Delivers the defined Pro market microstructure views.

**Technical requirements:** Render available depth and tokenized trade tape with source/freshness labels, venue attribution, and unavailable states.

**Acceptance criteria:** UI matches depth/trade fixtures; stale sources are marked; different securities cannot be combined by client controls.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MKT-04`, `P5-MDATA-05`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; Market Data Backend

summary: Validate and preview equity limit orders
description:
**Business value:** Delivers defined limit-order capability safely.

**Technical requirements:** Validate provider support, eligibility, price/tick, quantity/lot, buying power, expiry, and transparent fees; prohibit margin and leverage.

**Acceptance criteria:** Invalid or unsupported orders are rejected; valid input creates a bound preview; insufficient buying power cannot confirm.

**Dependencies:** `P5-ROUTER-02`, `PRE-003`, `BAL-003`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Web/Mobile; Compliance

**Business value:** Lets users submit and cancel orders with auditable state.

**Technical requirements:** Implement idempotent submit/cancel plus normalized pending, partial-fill, fill, cancel, and reject states linked to ledger and reconciliation.

**Acceptance criteria:** Duplicate submit creates one order; cancel is idempotent; fills and rejection match provider and ledger records.

**Dependencies:** `P5-MKT-06`, `P5-PRV1-04`, `P5-PRV1-05`, `P5-PRV2-04`, `P5-PRV2-05`, `EP-LED`, `EP-REC`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Partner Integrations; Ledger Backend

**Business value:** Protects paid execution and licensed data capabilities.

**Technical requirements:** Gate limit orders, provider comparisons, Level II, depth, and time-and-sales at server and UI layers; default deny unknown entitlements.

**Acceptance criteria:** Free cannot use limit orders or Pro views; Individual can use defined limit orders; only Pro can access Pro-only depth; API bypass fails.

**Dependencies:** `P7-E22-STR01`, `P5-MKT-05`, `P5-MKT-07`

**Owner:** Platform Backend; Web/Mobile; Billing

**Business value:** Creates an accurate portfolio without conflating distinct securities.

**Technical requirements:** Represent quantity and location by provider instrument, wallet/custody location, underlying, cost provenance, and settlement state; permit group-by-underlying display only.

**Acceptance criteria:** Two provider AAPL positions remain separate under one underlying; unsettled orders are not counted as settled holdings.

**Dependencies:** `P5-INS-02`, `EP-LED`, `WAL-002`

**Owner:** Portfolio Backend; Data

**Business value:** Prevents stale, duplicated, or fabricated holdings.

**Technical requirements:** Project settled ledger/provider/wallet events idempotently and compare against provider snapshots and indexed wallets with replay support.

**Acceptance criteria:** Event replay produces the same position; duplicate settlement does not double-count; missing or mismatched positions create discrepancies.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PORT-01`, `P5-PRV1-05`, `P5-PRV1-06`, `P5-PRV2-05`, `P5-PRV2-06`, `IDX-005`, `EP-REC`

**Owner:** Portfolio Backend; Reconciliation; Data

**Business value:** Gives users a consistent current portfolio value.

**Technical requirements:** Apply a documented tokenized-market mark to quantity with precise currency handling, source/freshness, and unavailable state; never silently use the underlying reference.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden positions produce exact values; stale/missing token data is labeled; partial totals are explicitly marked.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PORT-02`, `P5-MDATA-07`, `P5-MDATA-08`

**Owner:** Portfolio Backend; Quant

**Business value:** Bases liquidation value on realizable liquidity.

**Technical requirements:** Fan out eligible sell quotes for the exact position size using depth/slippage and quote expiry; report partial or unavailable liquidity without submitting an order.

**Acceptance criteria:** Thin-liquidity fixture returns less than last-price value; stale/ineligible quotes are excluded; no-liquidity returns unavailable.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PORT-02`, `P5-ROUTER-02`, `P5-PRV1-04`, `P5-PRV2-04`

**Owner:** Execution Backend; Portfolio Backend; Quant

**Business value:** Shows the gap between display value and realizable proceeds.

**Technical requirements:** Calculate estimated sell value from executable quotes and itemize expected slippage plus provider, network, conversion, and platform costs with expiry.

**Acceptance criteria:** Golden fixture reconciles market value, slippage, costs, and estimated proceeds; every deduction is itemized; expired estimates are stale.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PORT-03`, `P5-PORT-04`, `FEE-002`

**Owner:** Portfolio Backend; Quant; Finance

**Business value:** Gives users an understandable, honest portfolio view.

**Technical requirements:** Render grouped underlyings with distinct provider instruments, market value, estimated sell value, cost/slippage detail, freshness, and partial/unavailable states.

**Acceptance criteria:** A settled purchase appears after projection; UI matches APIs; distinct instruments remain visible; stale or unavailable estimates are clearly labeled.

**Dependencies:** `P5-PORT-01`, `P5-PORT-03`, `P5-PORT-05`

**Owner:** Web/Mobile; Portfolio Backend; UX
